question_overrides.pattern: Tell me about the most exciting project you've built (please type answer without AI)
question_overrides.answer: Built an agentic document extraction pipeline to ingest ESG data from more than 1000 company reports, using a LangChain LLM orchestrator hosted on Google Agent Platform, fine-tuned vision-language models (VLMs), OCR models, and PyTorch-based deep learning workflows. Designed and deployed our evals approach, which included building eval datasets, using Phoenix to instrument agent calls with OpenTelemetry, computing metrics, and running experiments across versions to improve visibility into agent performance and make the system more truthful, increasing precision from 50% with our initial zero-shot approach to 80% with a RAG-based system.

question_overrides.pattern: Describe a product or system you built from scratch (0-to-1). Include: what you built, your specific contributions, the tech stack used, and the outcome or impact.
question_overrides.answer: At Impatico, I built an agentic document-extraction system for ESG data from scratch. I designed the pipeline to ingest over 1,000 company reports and combined a LangChain-based LLM orchestrator on Google Agent Platform with OCR, fine-tuned vision-language models, and PyTorch workflows. I also built the evaluation approach: creating eval datasets, instrumenting agent calls with Phoenix and OpenTelemetry, and running experiments across versions. The result improved extraction precision from roughly 50% with the initial zero-shot approach to 80% with a RAG-based system, while making performance and failure modes much more observable.
